content: Filament (google/filament) license is Apache-2.0. Supports Vulkan backend but full headless/no-swapchain support on the Vulkan backend was still an open feature request as of GitHub issue #2007 ('Request for headless swapChain support with Vulkan'); headless support is more mature on Android via SwiftShader software rendering than via a real Vulkan headless path. Also a heavyweight, opinionated real-time rendering engine (View/Scene/Renderer, PBR material system, own matc shader compiler) mismatched to simple schema-driven single-pass execution.
